BiblicalUsage: Asnah is named once, among the families of the Nethinim who returned from exile — the temple servants, given to the Levites for the work of the house of God, counted by name on the way home.
TheologicalSignificance: No doctrine hangs on this family. But the list that holds it shows something I will not miss: even the servants were counted, and even the servants came home.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
